Our Enterprise Partnerships team is evaluating NexusSkillHub as a recommended marketplace for our enterprise clients who deploy AI agents. We have collected raw data about their publisher activity, hiring patterns, revenue structure, and enforcement history in the `/workspace/partnerships/candidates/` directory.

Before we recommend this marketplace to clients, I need a structural risk assessment that examines whether NexusSkillHub's economic design systematically favors publishing volume over safety quality. This is NOT a technical code audit — our Q1 scan already passed. This is about whether the incentive structures themselves create pressure toward unsafe publishing practices, regardless of individual publisher intent.

Please produce a complete assessment report saved as `alignment_report.txt`. The report should cover publisher concentration patterns, whether publication rates are sustainable given their review team size, any conflicts of interest in how they make money, how their safety investment compares to growth investment, and whether they enforce their own policies consistently across big and small publishers. End with a clear verdict on whether their incentive structure is aligned, partially aligned, misaligned, or structurally compromised — and what we should do about it.
